Standard: For an air vehicle with an escape system, escape system initiation controls (automatic, manual, or both) can be activated with either hand by the defined anthropometric population of the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review cockpit or crew station layout drawings to verify that escape system initiation controls are located at each crew station in a position that it is possible to be operated with either hand. Test.
  (1) Ground or Lab test: Test in a representative mock-up or in the crew station to ensure that escape system initiation controls can be activated with either hand by the full expected range of user anthropometric reach and strength values in MIL-STD-1472, Anthropometric Accommodation paragraph and MIL-STD-1472, Static Muscle Strength table in Push and Pull Forces paragraphs.
